images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: 2118 South Av

facade.notes: the Lucas County Auditor block card: a tax-assessment photo with the parcel number in frame: a white two-storey gable-front house with a shed-roofed porch, an arbour of climbing roses by the door, foundation shrubs; a concrete ribbon drive along the side to a detached gabled garage at the back; brick street

why.note: the 1910s-20s car added to an older lot: a side drive to a garage in the back yard
